verdict.rationale: Databricks hosts a live llms.txt file (HTTP 200) summarizing its documentation for agent consumption, and its CLI ships vendor-authored agent-oriented SKILL.md docs installable directly into Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc., going beyond a static llms.txt to structured agent-ready docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually use/parse the llms.txt effectively, and no evidence of a dedicated agents.md or similar broader agent-doc standard beyond llms.txt and skills.
